name: GetCallAuth
responseMappingTemplate:
#if ( $ctx.error )
  $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
#end

#set($isCognitoUser = true)
#if($ctx.identity.userArn && $ctx.identity.userArn.contains(":assumed-role/"))
  #set($isCognitoUser = false)
#end

## ---- ADDED: project access (blocked users do not get the project path) ----
#set($myProjects = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.stash.myProjectIds, []))
#set($excluded   = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.result.ExcludedUsers, []))
#set($inProject  = $ctx.result.ProjectId && $myProjects.contains($ctx.result.ProjectId) && !$excluded.contains($ctx.identity.username))

#if($isCognitoUser
    && !$ctx.identity.groups.contains("Admin")
    && $ctx.result.Owner != $ctx.identity.username
    && !$ctx.result.SharedWith.contains($ctx.identity.username)
    && !$inProject)
      $util.error("User $ctx.identity.username is not authorized", "AuthorizationError")
#else
  $util.toJson($ctx.result)
#end
